package pages

type Point {
  label: string
  value: int
}

external live WatchMetrics(id: string): Point
external live WatchMessages(room: string): string[]
external async LoadTitle(id: string): string

export component Gauge(id: string): html {
<section>
{await point = WatchMetrics(id)}
  <p class="value">{point.label}: {point.value}</p>
{fallback}
  <p class="pending">waiting…</p>
{recover err}
  <p class="failed">{err.code}</p>
{/await}
</section>
}

export component Chat(room: string): html {
{await messages = WatchMessages(room)}
  <ul>
  {for message in messages}
    <li>{message}</li>
  {/for}
  </ul>
{fallback}
  <p>connecting…</p>
{/await}
}

export component Dashboard(id: string): html {
{await point = WatchMetrics(id), messages = WatchMessages(id)}
  <p class="value">{point.label}: {point.value}</p>
  <ul>
  {for message in messages}
    <li>{message}</li>
  {/for}
  </ul>
{fallback}
  <p class="pending">waiting…</p>
{recover err}
  <p class="failed">{err.code}</p>
{/await}
}

export component Mixed(id: string): html {
{await title = LoadTitle(id), point = WatchMetrics(id)}
  <h1>{title}</h1>
  <p class="value">{point.label}: {point.value}</p>
{fallback}
  <p class="pending">waiting…</p>
{recover err}
  <p class="failed">{err.code}</p>
{/await}
}

export component Static(id: string): html {
<p>{id}</p>
}
